# WaterWave

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("WaterWave")`

One wave of the `Water` it is parented to. The first eight waves, in order, form the surface. A wave travels at the speed that deep water gives a wave of its length.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Amplitude` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | The height of a crest above the still surface, in meters. |
| `Direction` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The direction the wave travels in, in degrees about the vertical axis. 0 is along +X and 90 is along +Z. |
| `Phase` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The point in its cycle at which the wave starts, in radians. Use it so that two similar waves do not rise together. |
| `Steepness` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The shape of the wave, from 0 (a rounded swell) to 1 (sharp crests and flat troughs). |
| `Wavelength` | `number` | `40` | read/write | The distance from one crest to the next, in meters. |
